FN-1JDW3LL-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 415
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Juandalynn Givan
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/12/2024
House Bill 415 as introduced would: 1) repeal the Distressed Institutions of Higher Education
Revolving Loan Program; and 2) transfer any funds remaining in the Distressed Institutions of
Higher Education Loan Program Fund to the Education Trust Fund, which shall be immediately
available for supplemental appropriation for Fiscal Year 2024. As of April 1, 2024, the balance
of the fund was $29,998,245.70.
This bill would also decrease the obligations of the State Treasurer to administer the Program
and any monies in the Fund.
Page 1
